prior.note: The factory now includes synchronous checkpoint() and retains async captureCheckpoint (spec L181-L185), matching ModeHost and hostRuntime (contracts.ts:L8-L16; hostRuntime.ts:L65-L71).
The tick hook and equal-tick restore rule are specified (spec L148,L161-L162), matching the duel's interior and tactical tick updates (duel/step.ts:L126-L127).

The wire record remains underspecified. The spec calls EndRecord a discriminated union while keeping the sector TelemetryRecord unchanged (spec L163); that record has no mode discriminator (net/codec.ts:L80-L100). The named duel telemetry is a mutable accumulator containing prev and manoeuvre state, with no defined wire summary or checkpoint lifecycle (duel/telemetry.ts:L36-L55,L68-L75). Specify the tagged wire variants and how duel telemetry survives restore.

Restore must compare a stored map hash, but neither the header nor stored-value list contains one (spec L189-L195). The existing tactical flatten stores only the map's asteroid count (tactical/hash.ts:L15-L16). Add the map-hash field and its calculation and validation rule.
Mode selection, legacy sector default, mode-specific replay validation and a duel replay check are now specified (spec L173-L175,L345).
The ring moved to R-8; its limits, eviction, export scope and tests are specified there (spec L313-L319,L345,L353).

resolveLayout is listed as a retained dependency, but the spec says to pass it to rules.create, restore and validateCheckpoint (spec L164,L172) while their declared signatures accept no resolver (spec L143-L156). Add the resolver to those signatures or specify how the rules receive it without an argument.
Risk 3 now names metadata, client acceptance, event filtering and re-host policy, and keeps R-6 deferred (spec L368).
